description: Integration, Final Wiring, and Verification - Wire all new features together, ensure restock notifications fire from stock-add operations, activity logs are called from admin actions, update build_dp() to include any new routers, and perform final syntax/import verification.
steps: 1. Ensure build_dp() includes all routers in correct priority order. If any new routers were created in FEAT-001/002/003, add them.
2. Wire restock notifications into add_stock_items(): After stock is added, check restock_subs/{pid} and send notifications to subscribed users, then clear their subscriptions.
3. Wire activity logging into existing admin actions: In approve_deposit/reject_deposit handlers, ban_user handler, add_stock handler, create_product handler - add calls to log_admin_activity().
4. Wire low stock alert into purchase flow: After pop_stock_items() in the mail purchase handler, check if remaining stock is below threshold and alert admins.
5. Ensure VIP tier is recalculated after each purchase (in create_order and create_vpn_order and create_proxy_order).
6. Wire the trending calculation to use existing order timestamps - no additional data storage needed.
7. Ensure all new inline callback handlers have proper error handling (try/except around call.answer and call.message operations).
8. Review that all new FSM states have proper BACK_BTN/HOME_BTN handling to avoid users getting stuck.
9. Final syntax check: python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('bot.py').read())"
10. Verify all button text constants use _b() helper and are defined at module level.
acceptance_criteria: python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('bot.py').read())" passes without errors
Restock notification code exists in the add_stock_items flow
Activity log calls exist in at least: deposit approve, deposit reject, ban user, add stock
Low stock alert triggers after purchase when stock drops below threshold
All new states have back/home navigation handling
No duplicate callback_data strings across the entire file
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/Mail-Shop && python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('bot.py').read()); print('SYNTAX OK')"
Run: cd /projects/sandbox/Mail-Shop && grep -c 'callback_data=' bot.py to verify inline callbacks exist

Run: cd /projects/sandbox/Mail-Shop && python3 -c "import ast; tree = ast.parse(open('bot.py').read()); funcs = [n.name for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)]; print(f'{len(funcs)} functions defined')"
findings: All integration points were already largely in place from FEAT-001/002/003. (2) Added missing pay_referral_commission call in proxy auto purchase handler. (3) Added try/except to track_order_cb edit_text. All routers verified in build_dp.
